editorial.name: Escaped Masterpiece
editorial.description: A walking gallery portrait: a gilt frame surrounds an ivory blouse and flowing burgundy skirt.
editorial.alt: An ornate gold portrait frame around an ivory ruffled blouse and burgundy maxi skirt, with dark boots.
editorial.tip: Cut the frame from lightweight foam. Glue the corners, paint it gold, and add ribbon shoulder loops. Paint, glue and ribbon are extra supplies.

editorial.name: Fortune Teller
editorial.description: An ivory blouse and flowing black skirt, finished with blue and gold coins for a theatrical midnight oracle.
editorial.alt: Ivory billowy blouse, long black skirt, blue coin hip scarf and black boots.
editorial.tip: Tie the blue scarf over a skirt you own. Add a handwritten prediction card as a conversation starter.

editorial.name: Alien Botanist
editorial.description: A cream utility suit, silver antennae and a belt of tiny specimen bottles make a curious visitor from another garden.
editorial.alt: Cream utility jumpsuit, silver antenna headband, small green specimen bottles at the belt, silver gloves and brown boots.
editorial.tip: Put tiny fabric leaves in empty specimen bottles. Label them with invented planet names; no live plants or chemicals are needed.

editorial.name: Haunted Bellhop
editorial.description: A red and gold hotel uniform with a pillbox cap, white gloves and a room that does not exist.
editorial.alt: Red bellhop pillbox cap and gold-trimmed red jacket, black trousers, white gloves and black boots.
editorial.tip: Build a small pillbox cap from foam and cover it in red fabric. Pin on a paper badge for Room 13.

editorial.name: Masquerade Sun King
editorial.description: A radiant gold sunburst crown rises over cream layers and a theatrical white ruff.
editorial.alt: Gold sunburst halo crown, ivory tunic, white pleated ruff, black trousers and dark boots.
editorial.tip: Keep the layers pale and let the crown catch the light. A paper invitation to your solar court completes the character.
